title: Lord Baltimore Cake
description: This recipe for the classic cake delivers a rich and beautiful Lord Baltimore cake certain to impress your guests.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour three 9-inch round layer cake pans.
Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a small bowl. Beat egg yolks in a separate small bowl with an electric mixer until thick and lemon-colored; set aside.

Combine butter and sugar in a large bowl. Beat until very light and fluffy, scraping the bowl occasionally. Beat in egg yolks. With the mixer on low speed, add dry ingredients alternately with the milk and vanilla, starting and ending with dry ingredients. Divide evenly among prepared pans, spreading batter to the edges.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool in pans for 10 minutes. Turn out onto wire racks to cool completely.

Prepare Seven Minute Frosting (see Cook’s Note). Remove one-third of the frosting and place in a bowl with macaroon crumbs, pecans, almonds, cherries, lemon juice, and orange rind. Fold until thoroughly blended. Use as filling between cake layers, and use the remaining two-thirds of the frosting to cover the top and sides of the cake.
